description: This file contains definitions for transactional grains and a state class for a bit array, used for correctness testing within Orleans framework. It defines the BitArrayState class and several grain types for managing transactional state with bit arrays, including MaxStateTransactionalGrain, DoubleStateTransactionalGrain, SingleStateTransactionalGrain, and MultiStateTransactionalBitArrayGrain.

classes.name: BitArrayState
classes.description: A serializable class representing a dynamic bit array with bitwise operations, indexing, and string conversion capabilities.

classes.name: MaxStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A transactional grain managing multiple BitArrayState instances, representing maximum state across multiple transactional states.

classes.name: DoubleStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A transactional grain managing two BitArrayState instances.

classes.name: SingleStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A transactional grain managing a single BitArrayState instance.

classes.name: MultiStateTransactionalBitArrayGrain
classes.description: A base grain class managing an array of transactional BitArrayState instances, supporting bit setting and retrieval.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if this BitArrayState equals another based on the stored bits.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the internal value array.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets or clears a bit at a specific index.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator over the bits.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the bit array.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a bitwise operation between two BitArrayStates.
